children: Elon Musk said Starlink remains crucial to Ukraine's defense because, at least for now, it is the only communications system that cannot be jammed or destroyed. According to ChainCatcher, Musk said shutting down Starlink would cause Ukraine's front lines to collapse immediately, adding that this was not a threat but a statement of fact.

title: Elon Musk: Starlink Remains Critical to Ukraine's Defense
